items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says more is being done to tackle state threats than since the Cold War - and warns AI could be used to develop drones and bioweapons.

items.title: AI 'supercharging' security threats to UK, MI5 warns
items.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is "supercharging" security threats to the UK, including the potential development by terrorists and states of new killer bioweapons, the head of MI5 has warned.

items.title: UK growth forecast upgraded but higher energy prices to hit economy next year
items.summary: The prediction from the IMF comes as final preparations are being made for the first Budget under Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

items.title: Murder investigation launched after man, woman and two children killed in house fire
items.summary: A murder investigation into a house fire in Waterford has been launched after two children and two adults were killed.

items.title: Hundreds more prisoners being freed in second phase of early release scheme
items.summary: The second tranche of prisoners being released includes those serving up to two and a half years.

items.title: Bryan Cranston in 'deep despair' after death of Breaking Bad actor
items.summary: RJ Mitte, best known for playing Walter "Flynn" White Jr in Breaking Bad, has died aged 34.
